title: Adopt external PRs into durable revision tasks
summary: O8 on macOS now opens in its new native window.

sections.title: What this ship changes for you
items: O8 on macOS now opens in its new native window.
The Ring is the new o8 mark: new app icons, and the Ring in the window header.
The window has o8's own themes with swatches, a glass clarity setting, and zoom in and out.
A Working drawer pins to the bottom of the sidebar, and an empty thread shows an overview under its composer.
The thread header is cleaner, and Activity reads in one scroll with short ids.
Review findings go back to the agent that wrote the code, and its fix is re-reviewed against the saved findings.
A pull request from another tool can be adopted into one review task.
An approval is tied to the exact commit and the run evidence it reviewed, and only the assigned reviewer can submit it.

sections.title: Features
items: Adopt external PRs into durable revision tasks
Re-review saved author corrections
Complete review and recovery controls
Bind run evidence to exact-head approvals
Surface idle drafts and record decisions
Run macOS dictation without app servers
Draw the Ring in the window header and project identity
O8 Branding v1: brand kit, Ring app icons, header Ring, retired logo removed

sections.title: Performance
items: Cache 3.15 minutes of audit-tool compilation per warm PR
Avoid 2 Rust runners on 13/14 sampled PR heads
Remove 54s median no-op PR scheduling dependency

sections.title: Fixes
items: Record reviewed scanner findings so main reports cleanly
Keep the server out of the command-line bundle
Update two transport crates for new advisories
Anchor preparation helpers and preserve failure causes
Preserve first Stop timestamp on replay
Explain shared check pagination refusals
Bind review submission to the assigned reviewer
Preserve durable lead outcomes in status and waits
